item.title: The Dream Setlist for Ariana Grande’s Eternal Sunshine Tour
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and updates. Today, we're talking about one of the most anticipated tours of the summer: Ariana Grande's Eternal Sunshine trek. After a six-year hiatus from touring, Grande is set to take the stage once again, and fans are eagerly awaiting her return.
[Short music transition]
Host: Grande's tour kicks off on June 6th in Oakland, California, and will take her to major cities across the US and Canada, including New York, Chicago, and Montreal, before closing out with 10 shows at the O2 Arena in London. With her latest album, Eternal Sunshine, topping the Billboard 200 chart, and a vast catalog of hits, including songs from her 2020 album Positions, and her upcoming eighth studio album, Petal, Grande has a lot of ground to cover.
[Short music transition]
Host: In fact, with so much material to choose from, putting together a dream setlist for the outing is no small task. Our team has assembled a potential setlist that honors all of Grande's eras, from throwback tracks to musical interludes, an encore section, and more. We'll be sharing that setlist with you soon, but for now, let's just say that fans are in for a treat.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We'll be keeping a close eye on Ariana Grande's Eternal Sunshine tour and bringing you updates and analysis as it unfolds. Don't forget to subscribe to our podcast for more music news and updates.
